chunks: Al-Hasan ibn 'Abdillah ibn Muḥammad ibn 'Īsā narrated to me from his father, from al-Ḥasan ibn Maḥbūb, from Ṣabbāḥ al-Ḥadhā, from Muḥammad ibn Marwān, from Abū 'Abdillāh (peace be upon him), who said:
I heard him say: 'Visit the grave of al-Ḥusayn (peace be upon him), even if it is only once a year,' and he mentioned the hadith.
ai.seo_question: What is the minimum recommended frequency for visiting the grave of Imam al-Husayn (a.s.) according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This narration from *Kamil al-Ziyarat* establishes the annual visitation to Imam al-Husayn’s shrine as a recommended minimum (mustahabb), reflecting the Shia emphasis on commemorating the tragedy of Karbala as a living spiritual practice rather than a historical memory. The chain of transmission highlights the continuity of this tradition through the Imams, linking the physical act of ziyarah to the preservation of Islamic identity and the rights of the Ahl al-Bayt.
